description.value: A whole-brain voxel-based morphometry study comparing treatment-seeking problem gamblers, subjects with an alcohol use disorder, and healthy controls to evaluate regional grey matter volume differences.

spans.text: With whole-brain voxel-based morphometry we compared a group of 40 treatment seeking problem gamblers, 36 subjects with an alcohol use disorder, and 54 healthy controls to evaluate potential group differences in regional grey matter volumes

description.value: Cross-sectional observational study of three mutually exclusive male participant groups.

spans.text: Because most treatment-seeking PRGs were men, only male subjects were included in the study.

value: AUDs showed significantly smaller regional grey matter volumes than HCs in the left superior frontal cortex, left precentral cortex, right insula, right putamen, left thalamus, bilateral superior parietal cortex and right supramarginal cortex.

These reductions are consistent with previous morphological studies in treatment-seeking AUDs and suggest disruption of cognitive control, visuospatial, sensory integration, emotion regulation, arousal, attention and appetitive functions associated with atrophy in these regions.
